Native checks test only the listed AWS configuration or activity signals. Uncovered remainder: Multi-factor authentication is used to authenticate users to their organisation's online services that process, store or communicate their organisation's sensitive data.

Requests for privileged access to systems, applications and data repositories are validated when first requested — review approved privileged-access request tickets showing identity, approver, scope and first-use decision. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Native checks test only the listed AWS configuration or activity signals. Uncovered remainder: Privileged users are assigned a dedicated privileged user account to be used solely for duties requiring privileged access.

AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Native checks test only the listed AWS configuration or activity signals. Uncovered remainder: Privileged user accounts explicitly authorised to access online services are strictly limited to only what is required for users and services to undertake their duties.

Unprivileged user accounts cannot logon to privileged operating environments — review endpoint access policies and sign-in test records for privileged and unprivileged environments. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Privileged user accounts (excluding local administrator accounts) cannot logon to unprivileged operating environments — review endpoint access policies and sign-in test records for privileged and unprivileged environments. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Application control is implemented on workstations — review workstation application-control policy, deployed rule inventory and blocked-execution test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Application control is applied to user profiles and temporary folders used by operating systems, web browsers and email clients — review workstation application-control policy, deployed rule inventory and blocked-execution test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Application control restricts the execution of executables, software libraries, scripts, installers, compiled HTML, HTML applications and control panel applets to an organisation-approved set — review workstation application-control policy, deployed rule inventory and blocked-execution test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Microsoft Office macros are disabled for users that do not have a demonstrated business requirement — review managed Office macro policy, endpoint deployment reports and blocked-macro test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Microsoft Office macro antivirus scanning is enabled — review managed Office macro policy, endpoint deployment reports and blocked-macro test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Microsoft Office macro security settings cannot be changed by users — review managed Office macro policy, endpoint deployment reports and blocked-macro test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Internet Explorer 11 is disabled or removed — review managed browser configuration and endpoint compliance or browser behavior test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Web browsers do not process Java from the internet — review managed browser configuration and endpoint compliance or browser behavior test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Web browsers do not process web advertisements from the internet — review managed browser configuration and endpoint compliance or browser behavior test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

Web browser security settings cannot be changed by users — review managed browser configuration and endpoint compliance or browser behavior test records. AWS read-only checks cannot attest the required operating behavior.

requirements.name: Backup plan min frequency and min retention check
requirements.reason: Same pinned Steampipe control in every benchmark. Its text (AWS Config backup-plan-min-frequency-and-min-retention-check) requires at least one rule meeting frequency and 35-day retention: aws_nist_backup_plan_min_retention_35_days with an operator-declared frequency (UNKNOWN without it). The pinned query is retention-only per rule, kept as aws.c2b.backup.plan_rules_retention_35; neither alone completes the row, so it stays PARTIAL.
evidence: steampipe-mod-aws-compliance@803dda1f conformance_pack/backup.pp:31-34 control text; :158-182 retention-only query

requirements.reason: The requirement demands 4.2 Ensure Cloudwatch Lambda insights is enabled. The existing evaluator tests Lambda function has the source's Lambda Insights extension layer (reads Configuration, collection_status, FunctionName, Layers).

requirements.name: 4.3 Ensure AWS Secrets manager is configured and being used by Lambda for databases
requirements.reason: A read-only check can identify plausible Secrets Manager references and permissions; actual database secret retrieval requires code or runtime evidence.

requirements.name: 4.4 Ensure least privilege is used with Lambda function access
requirements.reason: The IAM role check detects direct AdministratorAccess attachment; a Lambda-to-role join and effective policy evaluation remains needed. Existing signal: IAM role does not have AdministratorAccess attached (evaluator role_no_admin). Additional bounded native signal: Detects declared administrator Allow patterns in native Lambda execution-role policy documents. This is a partial least-privilege signal; boundaries, SCPs, session policies, approved business scope and effective access remain unassessed.

requirements.name: Ensure the S3 bucket CloudTrail logs to is not publicly accessible
requirements.reason: Requirement: CloudTrail logs a record of every API call made in your account. These log files are stored in an S3 bucket. requirements.name: CloudTrail trails should be enabled in all regions
requirements.reason: Requirement: AWS CloudTrail is a web service that records AWS API calls for your account and delivers log files to you. The recorded information includes the identity of the API caller, the time of the API call, the source IP address of the API caller, the request parameters, and the response elements returned by the AWS service. CloudTrail provides a history of AWS API calls for an account, including API calls made via the Management Console, SDKs, command line tools, and higher-level AWS services (such as CloudFormation). Native evaluator scope: A logging multi-Region CloudTrail trail records read and write management events. The tagged checks directly assess the stated AWS configuration.

requirements.name: At least one multi-region AWS CloudTrail should be present in an account
requirements.reason: Requirement: AWS CloudTrail records AWS Management Console actions and API calls. You can identify which users and accounts called AWS, the source IP address from where the calls were made, and when the calls occurred. CloudTrail will deliver log files from all AWS Regions to your S3 bucket if MULTI_REGION_CLOUD_TRAIL_ENABLED is enabled. Native evaluator scope: Account has a logging multi-Region CloudTrail trail. The tagged checks directly assess the stated AWS configuration.

requirements.name: All S3 buckets should log S3 data events in CloudTrail
requirements.reason: Requirement: The collection of Simple Storage Service (AWS S3) data events helps in detecting any anomalous activity. The details include AWS account information that accessed an AWS S3 bucket, IP address, and time of event. Native evaluator scope: S3 bucket object-level read and write events are recorded by a logging multi-Region trail. The tagged checks directly assess the stated AWS configuration.

requirements.name: At least one trail should be enabled with security best practices
requirements.reason: Requirement: This rule helps ensure the use of AWS recommended security best practices for AWS CloudTrail, by checking for the enablement of multiple settings. These include the use of log encryption, log validation, and enabling AWS CloudTrail in multiple regions. Native evaluator scope: Home-region trail is logging, multi-Region, global, validated, KMS-encrypted and records all management events. The tagged checks directly assess the stated AWS configuration.

requirements.name: At least one enabled trail should be present in a region
requirements.reason: Requirement: AWS CloudTrail can help in non-repudiation by recording AWS Management Console actions and API calls. You can identify the users and AWS accounts that called an AWS service, the source IP address where the calls generated, and the timings of the calls. Details of captured data are seen within AWS CloudTrail Record Contents. Native evaluator scope: CloudTrail trail is actively logging. The tagged checks directly assess the stated AWS configuration.

requirements.name: CloudTrail trail logs should be encrypted with KMS CMK
requirements.reason: The control ID names CloudTrail KMS encryption, while its source description names CloudWatch Log Groups. The two evaluators test those separate KMS declarations; the source does not identify which one defines the passing scope or prove delivery into the encrypted log group; proposed aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_destination_kms covers the remaining scope.

requirements.name: CloudTrail trail log file validation should be enabled
requirements.reason: Requirement: Utilize AWS CloudTrail log file validation to check the integrity of CloudTrail logs. Log file validation helps determine if a log file was modified or deleted or unchanged after CloudTrail delivered it. This feature is built using industry standard algorithms: SHA-256 for hashing and SHA-256 with RSA for digital signing. This makes it computationally infeasible to modify, delete or forge CloudTrail log files without detection. Native evaluator scope: CloudTrail log file validation is enabled. The tagged checks directly assess the stated AWS configuration.

requirements.reason: Ensure that all Namespaces have Network Policies defined. The existing evaluator detects namespaces with zero NetworkPolicies but returns MANUAL when a policy exists; an exact policy-existence PASS still needs an evaluator.

requirements.name: Create administrative boundaries between resources using namespaces
requirements.reason: Create administrative boundaries between resources using namespaces. metadata.namespace checks reveal workloads placed in default; business and tenant boundary intent cannot be inferred from namespace names and needs architecture review.

requirements.name: Ensure that the seccomp profile is set to docker/default in your pod definitions
requirements.reason: Ensure that the seccomp profile is set to docker/default in your pod definitions. The mapped evaluator tests a declared Pod or container profile but does not resolve container overrides and inherited effective profiles; a combined PodSpec predicate remains.

requirements.name: Apply Security Context to Your Pods and Containers
requirements.reason: The existing predicate only detects a missing container securityContext; it does not test Pod-level securityContext or the contents of either context. Review the settings and effective values.

requirements.name: The default namespace should not be used
requirements.reason: The listed evaluators test explicit metadata.namespace on fifteen resource kinds. They do not establish use across all namespaced resources or implicit defaulting; complete inventory and applicability need review.

requirements.name: Maintain current contact details

requirements.reason: Never-used active keys for console users are an observed hygiene signal. A key created at initial user setup can later be used and pass this predicate; initial-setup timing and historical deleted keys need lifecycle evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure there is only one active access key available for any single IAM user

requirements.name: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less. The existing evaluator tests Active access keys were rotated within 90 days (Prowler) (reads access_key_1_last_rotated, access_key_2_last_rotated, true).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM Users Receive Permissions Only Through Groups
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM Users Receive Permissions Only Through Groups. The existing evaluator tests IAM user has no direct inline or managed policies (reads AttachedManagedPolicies, UserPolicyList).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*:*" administrative privileges are not attached
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*:*" administrative privileges are not attached. requirements.name: Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support. The existing evaluator tests A role with AWSSupportAccess exists (Prowler) (reads RoleName).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM instance roles are used for AWS resource access from instances
requirements.reason: An attached instance profile is observable, but the evaluator cannot establish that workloads use its temporary role credentials instead of embedded or external credentials.

requirements.name: Ensure that all the expired SSL/TLS certificates stored in AWS IAM are removed
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that all the expired SSL/TLS certificates stored in AWS IAM are removed. The existing evaluator tests IAM server certificate is not expired at the captured time (Prowler) (reads Expiration).

requirements.name: Ensure security contact information is registered
requirements.reason: SecurityContact.NamePresent from the Account Management contact inventory establishes alternate security contact registration. Evaluated checks: AWS account has a security alternate contact registered (reads Partition, SecurityContact, collection_status, absent).

requirements.name: Ensure that IAM Access analyzer is enabled for all regions
requirements.reason: All declared analyzer statuses are checked, but analyzer type and external-access coverage are not established.

requirements.name: Ensure IAM users are managed centrally via identity federation or AWS Organizations for multi-account environments
requirements.reason: SAML provider existence is a partial federation signal; whether IAM users actually authenticate via central identity requires owner or identity activity evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure access to AWSCloudShellFullAccess is restricted
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure access to AWSCloudShellFullAccess is restricted. The existing evaluator tests AWSCloudShellFullAccess is not attached to any identity (Prowler) (reads iam_user).

requirements.name: Ensure security questions are registered in the AWS account
requirements.reason: AWS does not expose account support security questions through a read-only API, so registration requires account-owner attestation.

requirements.name: Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists. The existing evaluator tests Root account has no access keys (evaluator aws_iam_no_root_keys).

requirements.name: Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account. The existing evaluator tests Root credentials have MFA configured (reads user, password_enabled, mfa_active).

requirements.name: Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account. The existing evaluator tests Root user with credentials uses hardware MFA (Prowler) (reads arn, true, User, Arn).

requirements.name: Eliminate use of the 'root' user for administrative and daily tasks
requirements.reason: Recent root inactivity is a partial signal; administrator practice and longer-term root use require owner review.

requirements.name: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater. The existing evaluator tests IAM password policy requires at least 14 characters (evaluator aws_iam_password_minimum_length).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse. The existing evaluator tests IAM password policy prevents reuse of exactly 24 prior passwords (evaluator aws_iam_password_reuse_prevention).

requirements.name: Ensure S3 Bucket Policy is set to deny HTTP requests
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure S3 Bucket Policy is set to deny HTTP requests. The existing evaluator tests S3 bucket policy denies every request made without TLS (reads Name, Sid, Policy, Statement).

requirements.name: Ensure MFA Delete is enabled on S3 buckets
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure MFA Delete is enabled on S3 buckets. requirements.reason: Macie enabled/automated discovery and the existing bucketDefinitions job check are partial signals. BucketCriteria job membership and completed classification must be checked; securing findings requires owner evidence.

requirements.reason: RDS instance storage encryption is tested by aws.rds.encryption; TLS parameters are unrelated.

requirements.name: Ensure that public access is not given to RDS Instance
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that public access is not given to RDS Instance. The existing evaluator tests RDS instance is not public with an open port in a public subnet (reads GroupId, IpPermissions, SubnetIdentifier, SubnetStatus).

requirements.name: Ensure that encryption is enabled for EFS file systems
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that encryption is enabled for EFS file systems. The existing evaluator tests EFS file system encryption is enabled (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions. The existing evaluator tests Every region is covered by a logging CloudTrail trail (reads HomeRegion, IsMultiRegionTrail, TrailARN, cloudtrail).

requirements.name: Ensure that Object-level logging for write events is enabled for S3 bucket
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that Object-level logging for write events is enabled for S3 bucket. The existing evaluator tests A logging trail records S3 object-level write data events for all buckets (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure that Object-level logging for read events is enabled for S3 bucket
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that Object-level logging for read events is enabled for S3 bucket. The existing evaluator tests A logging trail records S3 object-level read data events for all buckets (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled. The existing evaluator tests CloudTrail log file validation is enabled (evaluator aws_cloudtrail_log_validation).

requirements.name: Ensure the S3 bucket used to store CloudTrail logs is not publicly accessible
requirements.reason: The joined CloudTrail bucket check examines source-declared public ACL and policy grants; it does not prove effective public access after all policy conditions, access points, and account controls are evaluated.

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail trails are integrated with CloudWatch Logs
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail trails are integrated with CloudWatch Logs. The existing evaluator tests CloudTrail has delivered to CloudWatch within the captured prior 24 hours (reads Name, Status, collection_status, LatestCloudWatchLogsDeliveryTime).

requirements.name: Ensure AWS Config is enabled in all regions
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure AWS Config is enabled in all regions. The existing evaluator tests An AWS Config recorder is recording without a reported failure in the selected region (reads name, recording, lastStatus, config_recorder).

requirements.name: Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket. The existing evaluator tests Named CloudTrail trail's in-scope bucket has server access logging (reads Name, Logging, collection_status).

requirements.name: Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs. The existing evaluator tests CloudTrail trail declares KMS encryption (evaluator aws_cloudtrail_kms_encryption).

requirements.name: Ensure rotation for customer created symmetric CMKs is enabled
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure rotation for customer created symmetric CMKs is enabled. The existing evaluator tests Enabled symmetric customer managed KMS key has rotation enabled (Prowler) (evaluator prowler_rotation).

requirements.name: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs
requirements.reason: The evaluator covers only VPCs classified as in use. It does not establish flow logging on every other VPC required by this control.

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for security group changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect security group changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for changes to Network Access Control Lists (NACL). The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect network ACL changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for changes to network gateways. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect network gateway changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for route table changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect route table changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for VPC changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect VPC changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exists for AWS Organizations changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect AWS Organizations changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure AWS Security Hub is enabled. The existing evaluator tests Security Hub is enabled with a standard or an integration (Prowler) (reads EnabledStandards, ProductSubscriptions).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for Management Console sign-in without MFA
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for Management Console sign-in without MFA. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect Management Console sign-in without MFA (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for usage of 'root' account. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect root account usage (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for IAM policy changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect IAM policy changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for CloudTrail configuration changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect CloudTrail configuration changes (reads id).

requirements.name: Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Management Console authentication failures
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Management Console authentication failures. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect Management Console authentication failures (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for disabling or scheduled deletion of customer created CMKs. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect disabling or scheduled deletion of customer managed KMS keys (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for S3 bucket policy changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect S3 bucket policy changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Config configuration changes. The existing evaluator tests A CloudWatch metric filter and alarm detect AWS Config configuration changes (reads id).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure no Network ACLs allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports. The existing evaluator tests Network ACL does not allow all ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (reads Entries, GroupName); Network ACL does not allow TCP 22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (reads Entries, GroupName); Network ACL does not allow TCP 3389 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (reads Entries, GroupName).

requirements.name: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
requirements.reason: The native SSH/RDP evaluators inspect only in-use security groups. Unattached security groups can still permit world ingress to remote-administration ports and remain outside this evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from ::/0 to remote server administration ports
requirements.reason: The native SSH/RDP evaluators inspect only in-use security groups. Unattached security groups can still permit world ingress to remote-administration ports and remain outside this evidence.

requirements.reason: Every VPC default group must have no inbound or outbound rules, including unused groups.

requirements.name: Ensure routing tables for VPC peering are "least access"
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure routing tables for VPC peering are "least access". The existing evaluator tests Peering route tables do not route 0.0.0.0/0 or the requester CIDR over peering (reads VpcPeeringConnectionId, RequesterVpcInfo, Routes, Origin).

requirements.name: Ensure that EC2 Metadata Service only allows IMDSv2

The existing evaluator tests Account IMDS defaults require IMDSv2 in a region with instances (reads InstanceMetadataDefaults, HttpTokens); Non-terminated EC2 instance requires IMDSv2 or disables IMDS (evaluator inst_imdsv2_prowler).

frameworks.name: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark v2.0.0

requirements.name: Ensure Security Defaults is enabled on Azure Active Directory
requirements.reason: The directory_security_defaults evaluator tests isEnabled == true.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Multi-Factor Auth Status' is 'Enabled' for all Privileged Users
requirements.reason: The native evaluator checks MFA capability for privileged users. The proposed Conditional Access predicate checks policy coverage, but legacy per-user MFA status and sign-in enforcement remain outside these signals.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Multi-Factor Auth Status' is 'Enabled' for all Non-Privileged Users
requirements.reason: The native evaluator checks MFA capability for non-privileged users. The proposed Conditional Access predicate checks policy coverage, but legacy per-user MFA status and sign-in enforcement remain outside these signals.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multi-factor authentication on devices they trust' is Disabled
requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multi-factor authentication on devices they trust' is Disabled” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.name: Ensure That 'Notify all admins when other admins reset their password?' is set to 'Yes'
requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure That 'Notify all admins when other admins reset their password?' is set to 'Yes'” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.name: Ensure `User consent for applications` is set to `Do not allow user consent`
requirements.reason: Native semantic scope: azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_user_consent_disallowed: Current default role self-consent assignment only. Existing consents and other effective capability paths require separate review. Manual or separate-check evidence is required for the stated remainder.

requirements.name: Ensure ‘User consent for applications’ Is Set To ‘Allow for Verified Publishers’
requirements.reason: Native semantic scope: azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_user_consent_verified_publishers_selected_permissions: Selected default role policy IDs only. Verified-publisher and low-impact policy content, plus existing grants, remain unverified. Manual or separate-check evidence is required for the stated remainder.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Users can add gallery apps to My Apps' is set to 'No'
requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure that 'Users can add gallery apps to My Apps' is set to 'No'” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.name: Ensure That 'Users Can Register Applications' Is Set to 'No'
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.port.iam_user_not_allowed_to_register_application: PASS when `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateApps` is false.

requirements.name: Ensure That 'Guest users access restrictions' is set to 'Guest user access is restricted to properties and memberships of their own directory objects'
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest_user_access_restricted: PASS when guestUserRoleId is the Restricted Guest User template ID.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Guest invite restrictions' is set to 'Only users assigned to specific admin roles can invite guest users'
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest_invite_restricted: PASS when allowInvitesFrom is none or adminsAndGuestInviters.

requirements.name: Ensure That 'Restrict access to Azure AD administration portal' is Set to 'Yes'
requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure That 'Restrict access to Azure AD administration portal' is Set to 'Yes'” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Restrict user ability to access groups features in the Access Pane' is Set to 'Yes'
requirements.reason: The proposed Graph directory-setting source does not identify a concrete setting key for Access Pane group-feature restrictions. Inspect the tenant Access Pane setting or exported configuration and verify non-admin access is disabled.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Users can create security groups in Azure portals, API or PowerShell' is set to 'No'
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.port.iam_user_not_allowed_to_create_security_group: PASS when `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateSecurityGroups` is false.

requirements.name: Ensure Trusted Locations Are Defined
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.entra_trusted_named_location_exists: PASS when an IP named location is trusted and declares a range.

requirements.name: Ensure that an exclusionary Geographic Access Policy is considered
requirements.reason: The proposed policy signal can show an enabled geographic block policy, but the benchmark asks whether exclusionary geographic access was considered. Require a dated risk decision and approved policy or exception for the organization’s locations.

requirements.name: Ensure that A Multi-factor Authentication Policy Exists for Administrative Groups
requirements.reason: The native policy check only detects broad MFA coverage. The proposed predicate tests privileged directory roles specifically; administrative groups outside directory roles remain a manual remainder.

requirements.name: Ensure that A Multi-factor Authentication Policy Exists for All Users
requirements.reason: The native check detects some MFA policy coverage. The proposed predicate requires all users without exclusions; user-specific exceptions and authentication strength need review.

requirements.name: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required for Risky Sign-ins
requirements.reason: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required for Risky Sign-ins is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields.

requirements.name: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required for Azure Management
requirements.reason: The evaluator finds an enabled MFA Conditional Access policy for the named application, but does not resolve user exclusions, policy grant combinations or effective sign-in enforcement for every user.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Owners can manage group membership requests in the Access Panel' is set to 'No'
requirements.reason: The proposed Group.Unified setting key has no verified read-only mapping to the legacy 'Owners can manage group membership requests' tenant option. Require a dated Entra Groups setting export or portal evidence showing the option is No.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Users can create Microsoft 365 groups in Azure portals, API or PowerShell' is set to 'No'
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.entra_m365_group_creation_restricted: PASS when the unique Group.Unified setting has EnableGroupCreation set to false.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Require Multi-Factor Authentication to register or join devices with Azure AD' is set to 'Yes'
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.claude2.entra_device_join_requires_mfa: PASS when multiFactorAuthConfiguration is required.

requirements.name: Ensure That No Custom Subscription Administrator Roles Exist
requirements.reason: The requirement concerns whether custom subscription Administrator or Owner-equivalent roles exist. requirements.name: Ensure App Service Authentication is set up for apps in Azure App Service
requirements.reason: The evaluator reads only App Service Authentication platform.enabled. It does not establish an identity provider, token validation or protection of application routes, so application authentication remains incomplete.

requirements.name: Ensure FTP deployments are Disabled
requirements.reason: The evaluator blocks plain FTP but still permits FTPS deployment. The requirement calls for disabling both FTP and FTPS publishing.

requirements.name: Ensure Azure Key Vaults are Used to Store Secrets
requirements.reason: The proposal can find literal App Service settings with secret-like names, but it cannot establish where every application or workload secret is stored. A secret inventory and Key Vault references for all in-scope workloads remain required.

requirements.name: Ensure Web App Redirects All HTTP traffic to HTTPS in Azure App Service
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.app.https_only: PASS when HTTPS-only routing is enabled.

requirements.name: Ensure Web App is using the latest version of TLS encryption
requirements.reason: The evaluator enforces TLS 1.2 as a minimum. It does not establish the latest supported TLS version for App Service.

requirements.name: Ensure the web app has 'Client Certificates (Incoming client certificates)' set to 'On'
requirements.reason: The direct App Service clientCertEnabled check tests whether incoming client certificates are On; the removed check also required mode=Required.

requirements.name: Ensure that Register with Azure Active Directory is enabled on App Service
requirements.reason: The frozen CIS control concerns an App Service managed identity for outbound, secret-free access to Azure services. The signed read-only proposal checks complete scoped Web Apps GET identity.type, principalId and attached userAssignedIdentities; inbound authSettingsV2 Entra authentication and Graph app registration are separate evidence and are not prerequisites for this control. Coverage depends on a registered evaluator and complete current identity facts; this explanation alone does not establish automated coverage.

requirements.name: Ensure That 'PHP version' is the Latest, If Used to Run the Web App
requirements.reason: The proposed runtime-support catalogue has no identified source or version, so a configured runtime string cannot establish the latest or supported version. Review the App Service stack configuration against a dated Azure runtime support matrix.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Python version' is the Latest Stable Version, if Used to Run the Web App
requirements.reason: The proposed runtime-support catalogue has no identified source or version, so a configured runtime string cannot establish the latest or supported version. Review the App Service stack configuration against a dated Azure runtime support matrix.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Java version' is the latest, if used to run the Web App
requirements.reason: The proposed runtime-support catalogue has no identified source or version, so a configured runtime string cannot establish the latest or supported version. Review the App Service stack configuration against a dated Azure runtime support matrix.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'HTTP Version' is the Latest, if Used to Run the Web App

Verified-publisher and low-impact policy content, plus existing grants, remain unverified. Manual or separate-check evidence is required for the stated remainder.

requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure That 'Restrict access to Microsoft Entra admin center' is Set to 'Yes'” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. requirements.name: Ensure that 'Restrict user ability to access groups features in the Access Pane' is Set to 'Yes'
requirements.reason: The proposed Graph directory-setting source does not identify a concrete setting key for Access Pane group-feature restrictions. Inspect the tenant Access Pane setting or exported configuration and verify non-admin access is disabled.

requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.entra_trusted_named_location_exists: PASS when an IP named location is trusted and declares a range.

requirements.reason: The proposed policy signal can show an enabled geographic block policy, but the benchmark asks whether exclusionary geographic access was considered. Require a dated risk decision and approved policy or exception for the organization’s locations.

requirements.name: Ensure that an exclusionary Device code flow policy is considered
requirements.reason: An enabled Conditional Access device-code-flow block is a technical signal. The requirement also asks that the restriction be considered; require the documented risk decision and any approved exception.

requirements.reason: The native policy check only detects broad MFA coverage. The proposed predicate tests privileged directory roles specifically; administrative groups outside directory roles remain a manual remainder.

requirements.name: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required for Windows Azure Service Management API

requirements.name: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required to access Microsoft Admin Portals

Function environmentVariables and secretEnvironmentVariables expose credential-named inline values; arbitrary secret content in innocently named variables still needs content review.

frameworks.name: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v4.0.1

requirements.name: Maintain current contact details
requirements.reason: Contacts presence and distinct name, phone, and email counts are API-visible; whether those details are current and reach more than one actual person requires owner confirmation. Existing signal: Primary, billing, operations and security contacts are all registered and distinct (reads Partition, Contacts, collection_status, absent).

requirements.name: Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for all IAM users that have a console password
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for all IAM users that have a console password. The existing evaluator tests Console users have MFA configured (reads LoginProfile, MFADevices, absent, items).

requirements.name: Do not create access keys during initial setup for IAM users with a console password
requirements.reason: Never-used active keys for console users are an observed hygiene signal. A key created at initial user setup can later be used and pass this predicate; initial-setup timing and historical deleted keys need lifecycle evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or more are disabled
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or more are disabled. The existing evaluator tests Active access keys were used within 45 days (Prowler) (reads access_key_1_active, access_key_2_active, true); Console password was used within the last 45 days (Prowler) (evaluator prowler_console_45).

requirements.name: Ensure there is only one active access key for any single IAM user
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure there is only one active access key for any single IAM user. The existing evaluator tests Principal does not have two active access keys (Prowler) (reads access_key_1_active, access_key_2_active).

requirements.name: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less. The existing evaluator tests Active access keys were rotated within 90 days (Prowler) (reads access_key_1_last_rotated, access_key_2_last_rotated, true).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM users receive permissions only through groups
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM users receive permissions only through groups. The existing evaluator tests IAM user has no direct inline or managed policies (reads AttachedManagedPolicies, UserPolicyList).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM policies that allow full *:* administrative privileges are not attached
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM policies that allow full *:* administrative privileges are not attached. The existing evaluator tests Attached AWS managed policy does not grant administrative access (Prowler) (evaluator evaluate); Attached customer managed policy does not grant administrative access (Prowler) (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support. The existing evaluator tests A role with AWSSupportAccess exists (Prowler) (reads RoleName).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM instance roles are used for AWS resource access from instances
requirements.reason: An attached instance profile is observable, but the evaluator cannot establish that workloads use its temporary role credentials instead of embedded or external credentials.

requirements.name: Ensure that all expired SSL/TLS certificates stored in AWS IAM are removed
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that all expired SSL/TLS certificates stored in AWS IAM are removed. The existing evaluator tests IAM server certificate is not expired at the captured time (Prowler) (reads Expiration).

requirements.name: Ensure security contact information is registered
requirements.reason: SecurityContact.NamePresent from the Account Management contact inventory establishes alternate security contact registration. Evaluated checks: AWS account has a security alternate contact registered (reads Partition, SecurityContact, collection_status, absent).

requirements.name: Ensure that IAM Access Analyzer is enabled for all regions
requirements.reason: All declared analyzer statuses are checked, but analyzer type and external-access coverage are not established.

requirements.name: Ensure IAM users are managed centrally via identity federation or AWS Organizations for multi-account environments
requirements.reason: SAML provider existence is a partial federation signal; whether IAM users actually authenticate via central identity requires owner or identity activity evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure access to AWSCloudShellFullAccess is restricted
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure access to AWSCloudShellFullAccess is restricted. The existing evaluator tests AWSCloudShellFullAccess is not attached to any identity (Prowler) (reads iam_user).

requirements.name: Ensure security questions are registered in the AWS account
requirements.reason: AWS does not expose account support security questions through a read-only API, so registration requires account-owner attestation.

requirements.name: Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists. The existing evaluator tests Root account has no access keys (evaluator aws_iam_no_root_keys).

requirements.name: Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account. The existing evaluator tests Root credentials have MFA configured (reads user, password_enabled, mfa_active).

requirements.name: Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account. The existing evaluator tests Root user with credentials uses hardware MFA (Prowler) (reads arn, true, User, Arn).

requirements.name: Eliminate use of the 'root' user for administrative and daily tasks
requirements.reason: Recent root inactivity is a partial signal; administrator practice and longer-term root use require owner review.

requirements.name: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater. The existing evaluator tests IAM password policy requires at least 14 characters (evaluator aws_iam_password_minimum_length).

requirements.name: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse. The existing evaluator tests IAM password policy prevents reuse of exactly 24 prior passwords (evaluator aws_iam_password_reuse_prevention).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure MFA Delete is enabled on S3 buckets. The existing evaluator tests S3 bucket has MFA Delete enabled (reads Versioning, collection_status, MFADelete).

requirements.reason: The evaluator checks IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets, but does not establish BlockPublicAcls and BlockPublicPolicy for each bucket. Those two Block Public Access settings remain untested.

requirements.name: Ensure that encryption is enabled for EFS file systems
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that encryption is enabled for EFS file systems. The existing evaluator tests EFS file system encryption is enabled (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure AWS Config is enabled in all regions. The existing evaluator tests An AWS Config recorder is recording without a reported failure in the selected region (reads name, recording, lastStatus, config_recorder).

requirements.name: Ensure that server access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that server access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket. The existing evaluator tests Named CloudTrail trail's in-scope bucket has server access logging (reads Name, Logging, collection_status).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs. The existing evaluator tests CloudTrail trail declares KMS encryption (evaluator aws_cloudtrail_kms_encryption).

requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure rotation for customer-created symmetric CMKs is enabled. The existing evaluator tests Enabled symmetric customer managed KMS key has rotation enabled (Prowler) (evaluator prowler_rotation).

requirements.name: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs
requirements.reason: The evaluator covers only VPCs classified as in use. It does not establish flow logging on every other VPC required by this control.

requirements.name: Ensure that object-level logging for write events is enabled for S3 buckets
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that object-level logging for write events is enabled for S3 buckets. The existing evaluator tests A logging trail records S3 object-level write data events for all buckets (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.name: Ensure that object-level logging for read events is enabled for S3 buckets
requirements.reason: The requirement demands Ensure that object-level logging for read events is enabled for S3 buckets. The existing evaluator tests A logging trail records S3 object-level read data events for all buckets (evaluator evaluate).

requirements.reason: The native SSH/RDP evaluators inspect only in-use security groups. Unattached security groups can still permit world ingress to remote-administration ports and remain outside this evidence.

requirements.name: Ensure soft delete for Azure File Shares is Enabled
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_delete_enabled: PASS when file-share soft delete is enabled.

requirements.name: Ensure 'SMB protocol version' is set to 'SMB 3.1.1' or higher for SMB file shares
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.storage_smb_version_3_1_1: PASS when the semicolon-separated versions string contains only SMB3.1.1 after normalization.

requirements.name: Ensure 'SMB channel encryption' is set to 'AES-256-GCM' or higher for SMB file shares
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.storage_smb_channel_encryption_aes_256_gcm: PASS when the semicolon-separated channelEncryption string contains only AES-256-GCM after normalization.

requirements.name: Ensure that soft delete for blobs on Azure Blob Storage storage accounts is Enabled
requirements.reason: The replacement checks blob-service deleteRetentionPolicy.enabled on each storage account. The removed evaluator also required at least seven retention days, which is stricter than this enabled-only requirement.

requirements.name: Ensure 'Versioning' is set to 'Enabled' on Azure Blob Storage storage accounts
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.storage.blob_versioning: PASS when `properties.isVersioningEnabled` is true.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Enable key rotation reminders' is enabled for each Storage Account
requirements.reason: The native evaluator requires keyPolicy.keyExpirationPeriodInDays to equal exactly 90. The requirement asks whether rotation reminders are enabled; a shorter positive reminder period is enabled but fails this evaluator, so the configured-reminder condition is not evaluated exactly.

requirements.name: Ensure that Storage Account access keys are periodically regenerated
requirements.reason: The evaluator uses a fixed 90-day age threshold for key1 and key2. The requirement says periodically; the organization’s approved rotation interval and evidence of actual key use and renewal remain to be checked.

requirements.name: Ensure 'Allow storage account key access' for Azure Storage Accounts is 'Disabled'
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.storage.no_shared_key: PASS when `properties.allowSharedKeyAccess` is false.

requirements.name: Ensure Azure Resource Manager Delete locks are applied to Azure Storage Accounts
requirements.reason: Ensure Azure Resource Manager Delete locks are applied to Azure Storage Accounts is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields.

requirements.name: Ensure Azure Resource Manager ReadOnly locks are considered for Azure Storage Accounts

requirements.reason: The proposal names an unverified Databricks cluster field enableEncryptionBetweenWorkers. Require a Databricks configuration export or vendor-supported attestation showing worker-to-worker encryption for each cluster.

requirements.reason: The proposed Databricks token-management fields are unverified and token expiry alone does not establish restricted use. Review workspace token policies, permissions, active token expiries, and exceptions.

requirements.name: Ensure that diagnostic log delivery is configured for Azure Databricks
requirements.reason: The evaluator checks six Databricks diagnostic log categories on Premium workspaces. It does not verify a destination or actual delivery, and non-Premium workspaces are outside this predicate.

requirements.name: Ensure critical data in Azure Databricks is encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMK)
requirements.reason: The evaluator reads only the Databricks workspace managedDisk.keyVaultProperties. It does not test in-transit encryption, DBFS or managed-services encryption, or which datasets the organization classifies as critical.

requirements.name: Ensure 'No Public IP' is set to 'Enabled'
requirements.reason: VNet injection does not establish the no-public-IP workspace flag; the dedicated Databricks evaluator checks that flag.

requirements.name: Ensure only MFA enabled identities can access privileged Virtual Machine
requirements.reason: The evaluator checks MFA registration or capability for identities with VM RBAC access. It does not prove that MFA is enforced on every privileged VM sign-in or inherited access path.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'security defaults' is enabled in Microsoft Entra ID
requirements.reason: The directory_security_defaults evaluator tests isEnabled == true.

requirements.reason: The native check detects some MFA policy coverage. The proposed predicate requires all users without exclusions; user-specific exceptions and authentication strength need review.

requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multifactor authentication on devices they trust' is disabled” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Notify users on password resets?' is set to 'Yes'
requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure that 'Notify users on password resets?' is set to 'Yes'” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure that 'Notify all admins when other admins reset their password?' is set to 'Yes'” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. requirements.name: Ensure that 'User consent for applications' is set to 'Allow user consent for apps from verified publishers, for selected permissions'

Verified-publisher and low-impact policy content, plus existing grants, remain unverified. Manual or separate-check evidence is required for the stated remainder.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Users can register applications' is set to 'No'

requirements.name: Ensure that no custom subscription administrator roles exist
requirements.reason: The requirement concerns whether custom subscription Administrator or Owner-equivalent roles exist. Literal wildcard-action checks can pass a custom role with an equivalent combination of actions or indirect grants. Review the subscription custom-role definitions, effective permissions and assignments against the built-in Administrator or Owner role.

requirements.name: Ensure that a custom role is assigned permissions for administering resource locks
requirements.reason: The evaluator only finds a custom role definition containing Microsoft.Authorization/locks/* actions. It does not prove that the role is assigned to the intended administrators; compare role assignments and scopes with the lock-admin roster.

requirements.name: Ensure fewer than 5 users have global administrator assignment
requirements.reason: The evaluator counts distinct principal IDs in active tenant-wide Global Administrator assignments. It does not expand role-assignable groups into member users, so fewer than five principal IDs does not establish fewer than five users with the role.

requirements.name: Ensure there are between 2 and 3 subscription owners
requirements.reason: The evaluator counts distinct direct Owner principal IDs assigned at or above the subscription. It does not expand Owner groups into members, so the number of effective human Subscription Owners may fall outside two to three.

requirements.name: Ensure passwordless authentication methods are considered
requirements.reason: An enabled authentication method does not prove consideration of passwordless adoption. Review the tenant authentication-method policy and recorded approval or exception for passwordless methods.

requirements.name: Ensure that Azure admin accounts are not used for daily operations
requirements.reason: Sign-in appId alone cannot classify an event as ordinary daily use, and a finite sign-in window cannot prove nonuse. Review named admin-account separation policy and sign-in evidence for the period.

requirements.reason: Guest access restriction tests guest permissions, not recurring review completion; use access review definitions and instances.

frameworks.name: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark v6.0.0

requirements.name: Ensure that Azure Databricks is deployed in a customer-managed virtual network (VNet)
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.databricks_vnet_injection_value: PASS when properties.parameters.customVirtualNetworkId.value is any nonempty string.

requirements.name: Ensure 'Allow Public Network Access' is set to 'Disabled'
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.port.databricks_workspace_public_network_access_disabled: PASS when `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Disabled`.

requirements.name: Ensure Private Endpoints are used to access Azure Databricks workspaces
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.port.databricks_workspace_uses_private_endpoint: PASS when at least one connection is Approved.

requirements.name: Ensure Azure Databricks groups are reviewed periodically
requirements.reason: Periodic review of Azure Databricks groups requires dated review decisions, group membership snapshots, reviewer identity, and disposition evidence. Entra directory role assignments and generic access-review definitions do not establish Databricks group reviews.

requirements.name: Ensure that Network Security Groups are Configured for Databricks Subnets
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.claude.databricks_subnet_nsg: PASS when both named customer VNet subnets have NSG references.

requirements.name: Ensure that Traffic is Encrypted Between Cluster Worker Nodes
requirements.reason: The proposal names an unverified Databricks cluster field enableEncryptionBetweenWorkers. Require a Databricks configuration export or vendor-supported attestation showing worker-to-worker encryption for each cluster.

requirements.name: Ensure that Users and Groups are Synced from Microsoft Entra ID to Azure Databricks
requirements.reason: Databricks SCIM externalId is not proof that user and group synchronization from Entra is configured and running. Review Entra provisioning configuration, scope, and recent successful synchronization events.

requirements.name: Ensure that Unity Catalog is Configured for Azure Databricks
requirements.reason: Ensure that Unity Catalog is Configured for Azure Databricks is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields.

requirements.name: Ensure that Usage is Restricted and Expiry is Enforced for Databricks Personal Access Tokens
requirements.reason: The proposed Databricks token-management fields are unverified and token expiry alone does not establish restricted use. Review workspace token policies, permissions, active token expiries, and exceptions.

requirements.name: Ensure that Diagnostic Log Delivery is Configured for Azure Databricks
requirements.reason: The evaluator checks six Databricks diagnostic log categories on Premium workspaces. It does not verify a destination or actual delivery, and non-Premium workspaces are outside this predicate.

requirements.name: Ensure Critical Data in Azure Databricks is Encrypted with Customer-managed Keys (CMK)
requirements.reason: The evaluator reads only the Databricks workspace managedDisk.keyVaultProperties. It does not test in-transit encryption, DBFS or managed-services encryption, or which datasets the organization classifies as critical.

requirements.name: Ensure 'No Public IP' is Set to 'Enabled'
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.port.databricks_workspace_no_public_ip_enabled: PASS when `properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp.value` is true.

requirements.name: Ensure only MFA Enabled Identities can Access Privileged Virtual Machine
requirements.reason: The evaluator checks MFA registration or capability for identities with VM RBAC access. It does not prove that MFA is enforced on every privileged VM sign-in or inherited access path.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'security defaults' is Enabled in Microsoft Entra ID
requirements.reason: The directory_security_defaults evaluator tests isEnabled == true.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Require Multifactor Authentication to register or join devices with Microsoft Entra' is set to 'Yes'
requirements.reason: The corrected native mapping reports azure.claude2.entra_device_join_requires_mfa: PASS when multiFactorAuthConfiguration is required.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'multifactor authentication' is 'enabled' For All Users
requirements.reason: The native check detects some MFA policy coverage. The proposed predicate requires all users without exclusions; user-specific exceptions and authentication strength need review.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multifactor authentication on devices they trust' is Disabled
requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multifactor authentication on devices they trust' is Disabled” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.name: Ensure that Azure Admin Accounts Are Not Used for Daily Operations
requirements.reason: Sign-in appId alone cannot classify an event as ordinary daily use, and a finite sign-in window cannot prove nonuse. Review named admin-account separation policy and sign-in evidence for the period.

requirements.name: Ensure that Guest Users are Reviewed on a Regular Basis
requirements.reason: Guest access restriction tests guest permissions, not recurring review completion; use access review definitions and instances.

requirements.name: Ensure That Use of the 'User Access Administrator' Role is Restricted
requirements.reason: The evaluator rejects every direct built-in User Access Administrator assignment. It does not evaluate whether usage is approved and restricted, nor inherited or PIM assignments.

requirements.name: Ensure that All 'Privileged' Role Assignments are Periodically Reviewed
requirements.reason: Ensure that All 'Privileged' Role Assignments are Periodically Reviewed is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields. Resource criticality, approval, or periodic human review requires an organization-defined baseline.

requirements.name: Ensure Disabled User Accounts do not Have Read, Write, or Owner Permissions
requirements.reason: The evaluator reads subscription-covering role assignments for disabled directory users. It does not cover data-plane ACLs, inherited group membership, PIM eligibility, or every read/write/Owner permission path.

requirements.name: Ensure 'Tenant Creator' Role Assignments are Periodically Reviewed
requirements.reason: Ensure 'Tenant Creator' Role Assignments are Periodically Reviewed is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields. Resource criticality, approval, or periodic human review requires an organization-defined baseline.

requirements.name: Ensure All Non-privileged Role Assignments are Periodically Reviewed
requirements.reason: Ensure All Non-privileged Role Assignments are Periodically Reviewed is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields. Resource criticality, approval, or periodic human review requires an organization-defined baseline.

requirements.name: Ensure that No Custom Subscription Administrator Roles Exist
requirements.reason: The requirement concerns whether custom subscription Administrator or Owner-equivalent roles exist. Literal wildcard-action checks can pass a custom role with an equivalent combination of actions or indirect grants. Review the subscription custom-role definitions, effective permissions and assignments against the built-in Administrator or Owner role.

requirements.name: Ensure that a Custom Role is Assigned Permissions for Administering Resource Locks
requirements.reason: The evaluator only finds a custom role definition containing Microsoft.Authorization/locks/* actions. It does not prove that the role is assigned to the intended administrators; compare role assignments and scopes with the lock-admin roster.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Subscription leaving Microsoft Entra tenant' and 'Subscription entering Microsoft Entra tenant' is set to 'Permit no one'
requirements.reason: The native subscription tenant policy check reads only properties.blockSubscriptionsLeavingTenant. The requirement also forbids subscriptions entering the tenant; verify the inbound tenant policy and the effective assignment separately.

requirements.name: Ensure there are between 2 and 3 Subscription Owners
requirements.reason: The evaluator counts distinct direct Owner principal IDs assigned at or above the subscription. It does not expand Owner groups into members, so the number of effective human Subscription Owners may fall outside two to three.

requirements.name: Ensure that a 'Diagnostic Setting' Exists for Subscription Activity Logs
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_setting_exists: PASS when at least one scoped diagnostic setting exists.

requirements.name: Ensure Diagnostic Setting Captures Appropriate Categories

requirements.name: Ensure the Storage Account Containing the Container with Activity Logs is Encrypted with Customer-managed Key (CMK)
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.activity_log_storage_cmk: PASS when every referenced, collected activity-log storage account has keySource Microsoft.Keyvault.

requirements.name: Ensure that Logging for Azure Key Vault is 'Enabled'

requirements.reason: Read-only Organizations delegation inventory can verify designated administrators are registered. Actual policy/service management by those accounts requires CloudTrail activity or owner evidence.

requirements.name: YBooting Up: Things to Do First-1
requirements.reason: GuardDuty and Security Hub give detection signals; internal reporting and containment structures require owner evidence.

requirements.name: YBooting Up: Things to Do First-2
requirements.reason: IAM and root MFA checks cover AWS console identities. Federated identities, remote access users, and other systems named by this requirement remain unverified.

requirements.name: YBooting Up: Things to Do First-3
requirements.reason: RDS/Redshift upgrade and SSM compliance are selected AWS patch signals. Unsupported guest operating systems, applications, hardware, testing, and timely deployment remain unverified.

requirements.name: Your Crisis Response-2
requirements.reason: GuardDuty and Security Hub show AWS detection capability. Internal reporting ownership, communication routes, and containment procedures require incident-plan and exercise evidence.

requirements.name: Your Data-1
requirements.reason: Encryption checks cover selected AWS storage services. The requirement asks how all data is protected, including its location, access, lifecycle, and non-AWS copies, which these settings do not establish.

requirements.name: Your Data-2
requirements.reason: Selected log and audit checks provide partial visibility into network, host and data activity; behavior review and full inventory remain manual.

requirements.name: Your Data-3
requirements.reason: An active Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall association tests one DNS filtering control. DNSSEC, resolver/query protection, external DNS paths, and approved domain policy remain unverified.

requirements.name: Your Data-4
requirements.reason: The retained checks give backup or recovery signals for selected AWS services. They do not prove regular automated backups and redundancy for every key system; RDS deletion protection is unrelated.

requirements.name: Your Data-5
requirements.reason: Backup encryption and deletion resistance have API signals; physical security and truly offline copies require custodial evidence. Existing signal: Backup recovery point is encrypted (evaluator aws_c2b_backup_recovery_point_encrypted); Backup vault has an encryption key (evaluator backup_vault_encrypted); Backup vault policy denies manual recovery point deletion (reads Effect, Resource, Sid). Corrected native semantic scope: aws.c2b.backup.vault_encrypted: Vault key metadata only. Encryption of each recovery point and resource-specific encryption behavior require separate evidence. Manual or separate-check evidence is required for the stated remainder.

requirements.name: Your Surroundings-1
requirements.reason: An enabled AWS Config recorder does not inventory user, vendor, or business-partner network connections. Review IAM/identity-provider inventories, network connection registers, and the approved asset inventory.

requirements.name: Your Surroundings-2
requirements.reason: IAM and root MFA checks cover AWS console identities. Federated identities, external users, and remote access outside IAM still need identity-provider and access-system evidence.

requirements.name: Your Surroundings-3
requirements.reason: The retained IAM policy checks catch selected administrator grants. They do not compare each principal’s effective permissions with an approved job-specific need-to-know matrix.

requirements.name: Your Surroundings-4
requirements.reason: Password-history policy limits reuse within IAM, but password uniqueness across users and external accounts cannot be read; owner evidence remains necessary.

requirements.name: Your Systems-1
requirements.reason: SSM management and compliance supply partial asset inventory signals; complete hardware/software inventory remains an organizational process.

requirements.name: Your Systems-2
requirements.reason: Redshift and RDS auto-upgrade settings cover those managed services; OS and third-party software auto updates remain unverified.

requirements.name: Your Systems-3
requirements.reason: The listed AWS service settings give resource-level hardening signals. Hardware, operating systems, third-party software, and an approved baseline for every asset remain outside these checks.

requirements.name: Article 25 Data protection by design and by default
requirements.reason: Native checks test only the listed AWS configuration or activity signals. Uncovered remainder: To obtain the latest version of the official guide, please visit https://gdpr-info.eu/art-25-gdpr/. Taking into account the state of the art, the cost of implementation and the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing as well as the risks of varying likelihood and severity for rights and freedoms of natural persons posed by the processing, the controller shall, both at the time of the determination of the means for processing and at the time of the processing itself, implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, such as pseudonymisation, which are designed to implement data-protection principles, such as data minimisation, in an effective manner and to integrate the necessary safeguards into the processing in order to meet the requirements of this Regulation and protect the rights of data subjects. The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for ensuring that, by default, only personal data which are necessary for each specific purpose of the processing are processed. That obligation applies to the amount of personal data collected, the extent of their processing, the period of their storage and their accessibility. In particular, such measures shall ensure that by default personal data are not made accessible without the individual's intervention to an indefinite number of natural persons. An approved certification mechanism pursuant to Article 42 may be used as an element to demonstrate compliance with the requirements set out in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article. Additional bounded native signal: Evaluates the bounded enclave kms key requires attestation on sensitive policy allows. The upstream source links this security topic to this requirement; remaining process, approval and historical obligations are unchanged.

requirements.name: Article 30 Records of processing activities
requirements.reason: Native checks test only the listed AWS configuration or activity signals. Uncovered remainder: To obtain the latest version of the official guide, please visit https://www.privacy-regulation.eu/en/article-30-records-of-processing-activities-GDPR.htm. Each controller and, where applicable, the controller's representative, shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility. That record shall contain all of the following information like the name and contact details of the controller and where applicable, the joint controller, the controller's representative and the data protection officer, the purposes of the processing etc. Each processor and where applicable, the processor's representative shall maintain a record of all categories of processing activities carried out on behalf of a controller, containing the name and contact details of the processor or processors and of each controller on behalf of which the processor is acting, and, where applicable of the controller's or the processor's representative, and the data protection officer, where applicable, transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation, including the identification of that third country or international organisation and, in the case of transfers referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1), the documentation of suitable safeguards. The records referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be in writing, including in electronic form. The controller or the processor and, where applicable, the controller's or the processor's representative, shall make the record available to the supervisory authority on request. The obligations referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply to an enterprise or an organisation employing fewer than 250 persons unless the processing it carries out is likely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, the processing is not occasional, or the processing includes special categories of data as referred to in Article 9(1) or personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10.

requirements.name: Network Sniffing
requirements.reason: Native checks test only the listed AWS configuration or activity signals. Uncovered remainder: Adversaries may sniff network traffic to capture information about an environment, including authentication material passed over the network. Network sniffing refers to using the network interface on a system to monitor or capture information sent over a wired or wireless connection. An adversary may place a network interface into promiscuous mode to passively access data in transit over the network, or use span ports to capture a larger amount of data.

requirements.name: Network Service Discovery
requirements.reason: Native checks test only the listed AWS configuration or activity signals. Uncovered remainder: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation. Common methods to acquire this information include port and/or vulnerability scans using tools that are brought onto a system.
